ownership.precedent: ColdHubs pay-as-you-store model: 7 units in Northeast Nigeria markets (Dec 2020 to Jan 2021), N100 per crate per day, about USD 40,000 per unit and USD 150 a month to run (IFPRI, 2023)

labels.roof: footprints from OSM building outlines: the buildings touching the site's own OSM outline, else the buildings containing the site point, else the single nearest building within 30 m; usable roof = footprint x an ASSUMPTION usable share (0.3 to 0.7) x an ASSUMPTION 0.12 to 0.20 kWp per m2; no building: ground inside the compound, or unknown where OSM maps no building within 250 m
labels.security: each measure names its basis: the World Bank's anti-theft list, or our design standard
labels.ownership: PROPOSED model with the precedent named in each row; operators to be confirmed with partners
labels.load: one ColdHubs-type room per market (about 3 t, 150 crates, 5.5 kWp; VERIFIED_SECONDARY); no kWh/day is published, so the load is DERIVED as the array's mean daily yield here, 24.1 kWh/day (23.9 to 24.4 over the weather years), 24 h
labels.lga: LGA of the nearest health facility
